canonicalIds.tidb: Unchanged TiDB Cloud management API provider.
canonicalIds.tidb_sql: New canonical SQL data-access provider. No migration or alias from tidb because the credentials and actions are semantically different.
canonicalIds.elasticsearch: Existing provider enhanced in place and retained as the canonical ID.
canonicalIds.opensearch: No duplicate provider ID. Product detection selects the OpenSearch-compatible PIT protocol inside the shared elasticsearch runtime.

oceanbase.boundary: New provider; MySQL mode reuses the shared mysql2 runtime and native EXPLAIN budget check. Oracle mode uses an Oracle-wire backend with read-only transaction, bound values, and bounded results.
oceanbase.evidence: Contract, generated catalog, typecheck, shared database security tests, and Oracle adapter/driver tests. Oracle validation uses the OceanBase-supported V$VERSION identity query; Trino cancellation and bounded query cleanup are covered by runtime behavior.
oceanbase.blocker: No real OceanBase MySQL-mode or Oracle-mode service was available for the required end-to-end matrix.

tidb_sql.boundary: New SQL provider reusing MySQL wire safety primitives without changing the existing tidb Cloud management provider.

maxcompute.boundary: New provider using @alicloud/maxcompute20220104 for project, table, and column/partition-column metadata. AK/SK and optional STS token remain encrypted server-side.
maxcompute.evidence: Official SDK contract, generated catalog, typecheck, endpoint SSRF checks, bounded credential validation, configured-project scope enforcement, and Control Plane regression tests.
maxcompute.blocker: No Alibaba Cloud account was available. The installed official Node SDK exposes metadata/control APIs but no supported SQL execution/result or Tunnel row-fetch API; preview/query remain intentionally absent and are not claimed.

hologres.boundary: New provider reusing the PostgreSQL wire runtime with Hologres identity from hg_version(), isolated pool keys, SSL, read-only transactions, and PostgreSQL scan budgets.
hologres.evidence: Contract, generated catalog, typecheck, and shared PostgreSQL/database runtime tests.
hologres.blocker: No real Hologres endpoint and account were available for version/type/SSL/query compatibility evidence.

hive.boundary: New Node-only provider using HiveServer2 Thrift through hive-driver. NoSASL and PLAIN/LDAP are implemented; Kerberos is not claimed.
hive.blocker: Kerberos requires an operator-installed native kerberos module and a real KDC/service principal.

trino.boundary: New Node-only provider implementing the official HTTP statement protocol, same-origin nextUri polling, DELETE cancellation, prepared statements, Basic-over-TLS or explicit no-auth, and bounded pages.

elasticsearch.boundary: Existing provider enhanced in place with product detection, response/error byte bounds, PIT/search_after stable pagination, terminal PIT cleanup, and Control Plane read-only lease policy. Existing management actions remain available outside Agent leases.

opensearch.boundary: Compatibility product of the canonical elasticsearch provider; runtime detects OpenSearch and uses its /_search/point_in_time response shape.
opensearch.actions: Same bounded read allowlist as elasticsearch.

controlPlane.reuse: All providers use the existing tenant/workspace/owner/visibility, encrypted credential store, ACL, revision, ConnectionLease, audit, catalog tier, and enablement path.
controlPlane.leasePolicy: The seven canonical data-platform services validate action ownership/executability and issue Agent leases only for declared bounded reads. Elasticsearch mutation, mapping, delete, reindex, and indexing actions are denied.
controlPlane.credentialExposure: Provider callers receive connection refs/leases and redacted results; credentials remain in the encrypted server-side store.
controlPlane.realLifecycleEvidence: TiDB SQL completed create, encrypted credential verification, validate job, lease invocation, audit/redaction, revoke/replay rejection, and delete through the HTTP Control Plane.

verification.tests: 173 files passed, 1 skipped; 1553 tests passed, 4 skipped

integrationNotes: Cherry-pick the implementation commit before this handoff commit.
Do not replace or migrate the existing tidb Cloud management provider.
Do not create an opensearch provider ID; retain runtime product detection in elasticsearch.
Keep OceanBase, MaxCompute, and Hologres beta until their external blockers are cleared with real lifecycle evidence.
Do not merge P2 as part of this delivery.
externalBlockers: OceanBase MySQL-mode and Oracle-mode services/credentials were unavailable.
A real Hologres endpoint and credentials were unavailable.
A real MaxCompute account and data-plane SQL result API were unavailable.
Hive Kerberos verification requires a real KDC/service principal and optional native kerberos module.
